{"summary": "The stage cluster shows no critical or high findings in the digest. Kubescape scores NSA at 70.0 and MITRE at 75.0, with failures concentrated in the shop namespace (missing network policies, missing resource limits, ':latest' image tags). Trivy reports 6 MEDIUM vulnerabilities (no CRITICAL/HIGH) and 3 workloads failing the PSS Seccomp control. The only admin binding is cluster-admin to Group system:masters, which looks like a platform default.", "targets": ["stage"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 14, "failed": 7, "skipped": 5, "score": 70.0}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 12, "failed": 5, "skipped": 5, "score": 75.0}], "findings": [{"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "No ingress/egress restrictions (network policies) on shop workloads", "resource": "shop/Deployment/cart, shop/Deployment/web (14 resources total)", "controls": ["C-0030"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0030 'Ingress and Egress blocked' failed on 14 resources, with cart and web given as examples.", "fix": "Add a default-deny policy then allow required traffic:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: shop
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Seccomp profile not set on workloads (PSS)", "resource": "3 resources failing Trivy PSS control 10 (not named in digest)", "controls": ["Trivy PSS 10"], "evidence": "Trivy PSS control 10 'Seccomp' failed on 3 resources; 16 of 17 PSS controls passed.", "fix": "Set in pod spec:
securityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Mutable ':latest' image tags", "resource": "shop/Deployment/cart, shop/Deployment/web, shop/Deployment/worker", "controls": ["KSV-0013"], "evidence": "Trivy KSV-0013 flagged ':latest' on 3 deployments in the shop namespace.", "fix": "Pin images to a version tag or digest, e.g. image: registry/app:<version>@sha256:<digest>"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Missing memory/CPU requests and limits", "resource": "shop/Deployment/web (9 resources for memory), shop/Deployment/cart (14 resources for resource policies)", "controls": ["C-0004", "C-0009", "KSV-0011"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0004 failed on 9 resources and C-0009 on 14; Trivy KSV-0011 flagged CPU not limited on cart.", "fix": "resources:
  requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi}
  limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 256Mi}"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Medium-severity image vulnerabilities", "resource": "stage cluster images (not itemized in digest)", "controls": ["Trivy k8s vuln scan"], "evidence": "Trivy reports 6 MEDIUM vulnerabilities and an empty critical_high_vulns list; no fixed versions are given in the digest.", "fix": "Run 'trivy k8s --report all --severity MEDIUM' to list the packages, then rebuild images on updated base layers."}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding cluster-admin", "controls": ["rbac_and_argo admin_bindings"], "evidence": "Binding cluster-admin grants role cluster-admin to Group system:masters, which looks like a platform default; no other admin bindings or wildcard roles appear in the digest.", "fix": "No change needed if default; restrict membership of system:masters and use scoped RBAC for people and CI."}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Other low-severity Trivy misconfigurations", "resource": "stage cluster workloads", "controls": ["Trivy k8s misconfig"], "evidence": "Trivy reports 14 LOW and 5 MEDIUM misconfigurations in total; only KSV-0013 and KSV-0011 are itemized in the digest.", "fix": "Run 'trivy k8s --report all' to list remaining misconfigurations and fix by workload."}], "not_checked": [{"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Repositories", "reason": "the digest contains no repo scan data"}, {"item": "Argo CD checks", "reason": "rbac_and_argo contains only admin bindings; no Argo findings were provided"}]}
